name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet chemist and professor who proposed the 'framework' hypothesis and founded the molecular layering method.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who experimentally substantiated the molecular layering method.

name: Anatolii A. Malygin
summary: Professor and student of Aleskovskii who continued ML research and authored this essay.

name: Victor E. Drozd
summary: Physicist and student of Aleskovskii who developed vacuum ML equipment.

name: Anatolii A. Malkov
summary: Professor and student of Aleskovskii involved in ML research and equipment development.

name: Vladimir M. Smirnov
summary: Professor and student of Aleskovskii who studied magnetic properties of solids.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist who invented atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) independently.

name: Riikka Puurunen
summary: Senior Scientist at VTT who initiated the Virtual Project on the History of ALD.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
aliases: St. Petersburg State Technological Institute (Technical University)
summary: Russian educational chemical engineering institute where Aleskovskii studied and worked.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: University where Aleskovskii served as rector and founded a department.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Soviet scientific academy where Aleskovskii was a corresponding member.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia where Aleskovskii studied and worked.

name: Proletarskaya
summary: Station in the Rostov region where Kol'tsov was born.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Gas-phase layer by layer deposition technology developed by Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov.

name: Framework Hypothesis
summary: Theoretical concept proposed by Aleskovskii regarding the chemical structure of solids.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
summary: Thin-film deposition method invented by T. Suntola, similar to ML.

name: Department of Chemistry of Solids
aliases: Department of Chemical Engineering of Materials and Electronics Products
summary: Department at LTI founded by Aleskovskii in 1967.

name: Department of Solid State Chemistry
summary: Department at LSU organized by Aleskovskii in 1977.
